newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks end lower on broad round of profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks end lower on broad round of profit taking.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks closed sharply lower Friday as profit taking clipped the market's gains after a record-setting week.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average lost 130.31 points, or 1.62 percent, to close at 7,890.46.
In the broader market, declining issues swamped advances 20-8 on volume of 590 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
